game.name: Nhl 08 (Europe)(En,De,Sv,Fi)
game.desc: NHL 08 on Xbox 360 is an ice hockey simulation featuring all 29 teams in the AHL (American Hockey League). Develop your skills with these teams until you are ready to enter the big leagues. Start from scratch and manage your team like a real manager while staying within the salary cap. Play realistic games that sometimes end in fisticuffs.
